approved_by: The team (team lead), approved in the project planning chat on 2026-10-28 before any Horizons comparison was run
rationale: 1 arcsec in azimuth and elevation: an independent public implementation using the same NAIF DE421/MOON_ME kernel family reports 0.05 arcsec agreement with Horizons, so 1 arcsec leaves 20x headroom for differing ephemeris versions while still catching frame, time-scale, aberration or observer-position mistakes (those produce errors of arcminutes or more). Operational meaning: at 89.45 S the Sun's elevation changes by at most about 1 arcsec per minute, so 1 arcsec corresponds to at most about one minute of sunrise/sunset timing, far below the hour-to-day scale of the outages the planner reports. 1 km in range: range enters only through the apparent semidiameter, where 1 km changes the Sun's by about 2e-6 arcsec. Declared before any comparison output was produced; do not change after viewing errors.
